today.title: What matters today
today.description: Overdue, due today, and anything Sifty believes belongs in your top of mind.
today.emptyDescription: When something needs your attention, it'll show up here. Until then, enjoy the quiet.

focus.description: Work you've committed to, sorted by Sifty's read on what to do next. Sliding the priority moves things; letting AI re-triage rebalances.
focus.emptyDescription: Move tasks here from Inbox when you're ready to commit to them.

inbox.description: Newly captured tasks. Review, then move them into Focus, Waiting on, or Someday — or just leave them; Today will pull what matters.
inbox.emptyDescription: Capture anything on your mind. Sifty will organize it before you next check.

waiting.description: Things you've handed off — to a person, an agent, or a process. Move them back to Focus when the ball returns; Today will nudge you when a deadline arrives.

someday.description: A quiet shelf for ideas that aren't urgent. Revisit when the season is right.

done.description: Finished work, newest first. Uncheck anything to send it back to Focus.
done.emptyDescription: Completed tasks land here, so checking one off never loses it.

board.title: Board
board.description: Everything on the board, by status. Drag a card to move it.
board.emptyDescription: Capture a task and it will land in the Inbox column.

welcome.title: Three example tasks, already sifted.
welcome.body: Capture anything in your own words — press <key>C</key>. Sifty sifts it into a clear title, the next step, priority, effort, labels, and subtasks. Every field stays editable, and the sheet shows why it decided what it did.
welcome.limits: Capture is unlimited. Free accounts get {sifts, plural, one {# sift} other {# sifts}} a day; your first {days} days include unlimited sifting.

plan.stale: The last plan did not finish. Re-plan to try again.
plan.idle: Sifty can re-rank Today against everything on your list.
plan.planned: Planned {time} · {moves, plural, =0 {nothing moved} one {# move} other {# moves}} · {considered, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}} considered

errors.couldNotStart: Planning could not start — try again.
errors.offline: Can't reach Sifty — try again in a moment.
errors.proFeature: Daily planning is part of Sifty Pro. Upgrade to have Sifty plan your day.
errors.fairUseCap: You've hit today's fair-use limit for sifting. It resets tomorrow.
